summary.headline: Venus and Mercury in Scorpio
summary.text: Astrological positions and conditions of Venus and Mercury in Scorpio, including latitude, stations, houses, terms according to Ptolemy and the Egyptians, triangles, decans, faces, monomoiria, exaltations and depressions. The text also identifies nearby fixed stars, including stars in Scorpio and Antares, and gives their coordinates, magnitudes, and distances from the planets.
